Coco Gauff and Jess Pegula contest the first all-American Cincinnati women's final since 1970. World number three Pegula leads former champion Gauff 5-4 in the pair's head-to-head record.

Osaka top seed Ann Li of the United States continues at the WTA 250 with a round-of-16 contest against Zeynep Sönmez. Plus, Japan's own Moyuka Uchijima takes on qualifier Mary Stoiana.
A big-name second-round meeting in Ningbo sees fourth seed Iva Jovic - who reached the last eight in Wuhan - go head to head with former world number four Jasmine Paolini.
World number one Elena Rybakina gets her Ningbo title defence underway against Polina Kudermetova, while Alex Eala and Diana Shnaider collide in round two. Belinda Bencic also features.
Taylor Fritz starts out in Lyon against qualifier Pierre-Hugues Herbert. Plus, Monégasque star Valentin Vacherot plays Luca Van Assche, while Belgian Zizou Bergs features in Brussels.
Stan Wawrinka attempts to extend the penultimate tournament of his career, taking on the top seed in Lyon, Flavio Cobolli. Wawrinka is set to retire at the Swiss Indoors next week.
